labs.title: Hello, Java Learner
labs.brief: Read a name from standard input and print a greeting using that name.
labs.objective: Java kya hai, kaise chalta hai, aur apna pehla program compile karke chalana.
hints: Use System.out.println with string concatenation.
The greeting needs a comma and an exclamation mark exactly.

labs.title: Swap the numbers
labs.brief: Read two integers and print them swapped on one line, separated by a space.
labs.objective: Variables, primitive types, operators, input/output aur type conversion ko confidently use karna.
hints: Use a temporary int to hold one value while you move the other.
Print with a space between the numbers.

labs.title: Count the vowels
labs.brief: Read one line and print how many vowels (a, e, i, o, u — either case) it contains.
labs.objective: String immutability, pool, comparison aur StringBuilder ko theek se samajhna.
hints: Lowercase the line first, then only check a, e, i, o, u.
Use a counter int and a for loop over line.length().

labs.title: Grade calculator
labs.brief: Read marks (0-100). Print A for 90+, B for 75+, C for 60+, D for 40+, else F. Print Invalid for values outside 0-100.
labs.objective: if, else-if, switch aur modern switch expressions se decisions lena.
hints: Check the invalid range before the grade bands.
Test the highest band first.

labs.title: Sum of first n numbers
labs.brief: Read a positive integer n and print the sum 1 + 2 + … + n using a loop.
labs.objective: for, while, do-while, nested loops aur break/continue par command.
hints: Keep an int sum starting at 0.
Use long if you test values above 65,535 — the sum grows fast.

labs.title: Reverse the digits
labs.brief: Read an integer and print its digits reversed. Keep the sign for negative numbers (for example -123 → -321).
labs.objective: Prime, palindrome, fibonacci jaise number problems aur recursion ka call stack.
hints: Take the sign out first with Math.abs, then put it back.
reversed = reversed * 10 + n % 10; n /= 10.

labs.title: Largest of three, with a method
labs.brief: Read three integers and print the largest one using a max3 method — not Math.max.
labs.objective: Methods likhna, parameters pass karna, return values aur overloading samajhna.
hints: Find the max of a and b, then compare that with c.
Return the answer from the method and print in main.

labs.title: Array sum and maximum
labs.brief: Read n, then n integers. Print the sum and the maximum on two lines.
labs.objective: Arrays declare, traverse, search, sort aur 2D arrays handle karna.
hints: Start max at nums[0], not 0 — otherwise all-negative arrays fail.
Use a long sum if n can be large.

labs.title: Rectangle with behaviour
labs.brief: Read width and height, then print area and perimeter using a Rectangle class.
labs.objective: Class, object, constructor, encapsulation aur object lifecycle par solid foundation.
hints: area = width * height; perimeter = 2 * (width + height).
Print the doubles directly; Java prints 24.0.

labs.title: Polymorphic areas
labs.brief: Read a shape type then its dimensions: 'circle r' or 'rect w h'. Print the area with two decimals.
labs.objective: extends, super, method overriding aur runtime polymorphism ka asli behaviour.
hints: Circle area = Math.PI * r * r.
Rect area = w * h; mark both methods @Override.

labs.title: Payment through an interface
labs.brief: Read a payment method (upi or card) and an amount. Print '<method> paid <amount>' with two decimals.
labs.objective: Abstract classes, interfaces, default methods aur SOLID ka practical use.
hints: Use String.format("%s paid %.2f", name, amount).
Assign the right implementation to the Payment variable.

labs.title: Day type with an enum
labs.brief: Read a day number 1-7. Print WEEKEND for 6 and 7, WEEKDAY for 1-5, INVALID otherwise. Use an enum and a switch expression.
labs.objective: Packages, enums, records, sealed types, annotations aur generics ka first look.
hints: A switch expression over day can return the enum constant.
Group days with case 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 -> DayType.WEEKDAY.

labs.title: Safe division
labs.brief: Read two integers. Print a / b. If b is zero, print 'cannot divide by zero' instead of crashing.
labs.objective: Checked/unchecked exceptions, try/catch/finally aur custom exceptions ko theek se use karna.
hints: Wrap the division in try/catch ArithmeticException.
You may also check b == 0 first — say which approach you chose and why.

labs.title: Word frequency, sorted
labs.brief: Read n, then n words. Print each distinct word and its count as word=count, sorted alphabetically.
labs.objective: List, Set, Map, Queue aur unke trade-offs ko complexity ke saath samajhna.
hints: freq.merge(word, 1, Integer::sum) counts in one line.
TreeMap already sorts keys alphabetically.

labs.title: Generic maximum
labs.brief: Read n then n integers. Print the largest using a generic <T extends Comparable<T>> max method.
labs.objective: Type-safe generic code, bounds, wildcards aur autoboxing ke traps.
hints: Start with values.get(0) and compare each element with compareTo.
Return the element whose compareTo is greater.

labs.title: Save the lines
labs.brief: Read n, then n lines from input. Write them to a temp file, read the file back, and print 'saved N lines'.
labs.objective: Files, streams, readers/writers, NIO aur try-with-resources se safe I/O.
hints: Files.write(path, lines, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).
Count with Files.readAllLines(file).size().

labs.title: Sum of squares of evens
labs.brief: Read n then n integers. Print the sum of the squares of the even numbers, using a stream.
labs.objective: Lambdas, functional interfaces, Streams aur Optional se data pipelines banana.
hints: filter(n -> n % 2 == 0).mapToInt(n -> n * n).sum().
mapToInt avoids boxing and gives sum() directly.

labs.title: Thread-safe total
labs.brief: Start two threads that each increment a shared counter 1000 times. Join both and print the final value (2000).
labs.objective: Threads, race conditions, synchronization, executors aur CompletableFuture.
hints: Use AtomicInteger or a synchronized block around count++.
Join both threads before printing.

labs.title: Repository CRUD
labs.brief: Read n, then n 'id name' pairs. Print the number of rows, then the rows sorted by id as id=name.
labs.objective: JDBC, SQL integration, Maven/Gradle, REST concepts aur Spring Boot ka mental model.
hints: TreeMap keeps ids sorted automatically.
Print the size first, then each entry.

labs.title: Discount strategy
labs.brief: Read a strategy (festival or none) and an amount. Print the final amount with two decimals: festival gives 10% off, none gives no change.
labs.objective: JVM internals, design patterns, clean code, testing aur interview readiness.
hints: Use a -> a * 0.9 for festival and a -> a for none.
Print with System.out.printf("%.2f%n", result).

labs.title: Expense tracker by category
labs.brief: Group expenses by category, total them, and print a sorted report.
labs.objective: Practise HashMap/TreeMap aggregation and formatted totals.
hints: TreeMap gives sorted keys.
merge(category, amount, Integer::sum) accumulates.

labs.title: Command-line to-do list
labs.brief: Implement add, done and list commands for an in-memory task list.
labs.objective: Practise List operations, index handling and loop-driven menus.

tests.name: add done list
tests.stdin:
add buy milk
add call mom
done 1
list
end

hints: Read add text with nextLine().
Track done flags in a parallel List<Boolean> or a Task class.

labs.title: Student gradebook
labs.brief: Print each student's letter grade and the class average.
labs.objective: Practise classes, records and formatted output.
labs.expected:
Aman: A
Priya: B
Ravi: F
Average: 68.33

tests.name: three students
tests.stdout:
Aman: A
Priya: B
Ravi: F
Average: 68.33

hints: Use printf(Locale.ROOT, "%.2f%n", avg).

labs.title: Multi-account bank
labs.brief: Open accounts, deposit, withdraw and print balances.
labs.objective: Practise encapsulation across several objects and command parsing.

tests.name: two accounts
tests.stdin:
open 1
open 2
deposit 1 100
deposit 2 50
balance 2
end

hints: Map<Integer, Account> keyed by account id.
Validate withdrawals inside the Account class.

labs.title: Library catalogue search
labs.brief: Add titles, search by keyword and count the catalogue.
labs.objective: Practise lists, case-insensitive search and string handling.

tests.name: find and count
tests.stdin:
add Clean Code
add Effective Java
find Java
count
end

tests.name: no match
tests.stdin:
add Clean Code
find Python
count
end

hints: Store titles in an ArrayList<String>.
Use toLowerCase().contains(keyword.toLowerCase()).

labs.title: Word frequency report
labs.brief: Print words by descending frequency, ties alphabetically.
labs.objective: Practise stream grouping, comparators and formatting.
hints: split("\\s+") gives the words.
Sort entries by count desc, then key asc.

labs.title: Celsius to Fahrenheit table
labs.brief: Print a conversion table from start to end in steps.
labs.objective: Practise loops, arithmetic and formatted output.
hints: Use double for the result.

labs.title: Password validator
labs.brief: Check length, digit and uppercase rules and list every violation.
labs.objective: Practise String methods and multiple conditions.

tests.name: all failures
tests.stdout:
Too short
No digit
No uppercase

hints: Character.isDigit and Character.isUpperCase.
Print violations in the documented order.

labs.title: Palindrome sentence
labs.brief: Ignore case and spaces and decide whether the sentence reads the same backwards.
labs.objective: Practise StringBuilder and normalisation.
hints: Remove spaces and lowercase first.
new StringBuilder(clean).reverse().toString().

labs.title: Prime sieve
labs.brief: Print all primes up to n with the sieve of Eratosthenes.
labs.objective: Practise arrays, nested loops and boolean flags.
hints: Start with every number assumed prime.
Mark multiples of each prime as composite.

labs.title: GCD and LCM calculator
labs.brief: Print the greatest common divisor and least common multiple of two numbers.
labs.objective: Practise loops, modulo and long arithmetic.
hints: Euclid: gcd(a,b) = gcd(b, a%b).
lcm = a / gcd * b to avoid overflow.

labs.title: Matrix calculator
labs.brief: Add or multiply two n×n matrices based on the operation.
labs.objective: Practise 2D arrays, nested loops and command input.
hints: Read both matrices before computing.
Multiplication needs a third loop over the shared dimension.

labs.title: Generate binary strings
labs.brief: Print every binary string of length n in lexicographic order using recursion.
labs.objective: Practise recursive backtracking.
hints: Append '0', recurse, then append '1' and recurse.
Print when the prefix length equals n.

labs.title: Contact book
labs.brief: Add contacts, look one up by name and list them sorted.
labs.objective: Practise TreeMap put/get and iteration.

tests.name: find and list
tests.stdin:
add Aman 123
add Ravi 456
find Aman
list
end

hints: TreeMap<String,String> sorts names.
find prints the phone or not found.

labs.title: Shopping cart total
labs.brief: Add items with quantity and price, then print the cart total.
labs.objective: Practise object modelling and double arithmetic.

tests.name: two items
tests.stdin:
add pen 2 10
add book 1 50
total
end

hints: Keep a running double total.
Format with printf(Locale.ROOT, "%.2f%n", total).

labs.title: Sales revenue report
labs.brief: Aggregate revenue per product and print it sorted with 2 decimals.
labs.objective: Practise stream grouping and summingDouble.
hints: Multiply units by price before grouping.
summingDouble with TreeMap::new.

labs.title: CSV summary with file I/O
labs.brief: Write rows to a CSV file, read them back and report the row count and top score.
labs.objective: Practise Files.writeString/readAllLines and try-with-resources discipline.
hints: Build the CSV text with a StringBuilder.
Track the best row while parsing.

labs.title: Threaded sum of squares
labs.brief: Split the array across four threads and print the combined sum of squares.
labs.objective: Practise threads, joins and safe result collection.
hints: Give each thread a slice of the array.
Sum per-thread results after join(), or use AtomicLong.

labs.title: Generic stack
labs.brief: Implement a generic stack and run push/pop/peek/size commands on strings.
labs.objective: Practise generic classes and ArrayDeque.

tests.name: push pop size
tests.stdin:
push a
push b
pop
size
end

hints: Wrap a Deque<T> and delegate.
pop on the head keeps LIFO order.

labs.title: Quiz scoring engine
labs.brief: Compare given answers with the correct ones and print the score.
labs.objective: Practise string comparison, loops and simple class design.

tests.name: two of three
tests.stdin:
3
A A
B C
C C

hints: Compare with equalsIgnoreCase.
Print correct/total.
